about: field is a non-geographical space where experiments for the outdoors happen.

quote: To do the useful thing, to say the courageous thing, to contemplate the beautiful thing.

principles.title: built outside, tested outside.
principles.text: nothing leaves the studio until it has spent real time in weather, dirt and daylight.

principles.title: slow on purpose.
principles.text: we'd rather make one thing that lasts a lifetime than ten that last a season.

principles.title: small by design.
principles.text: a few people, a few projects. whoever you talk to is the one making it.

principles.title: the place is the brief.
principles.text: we start from a place and the people in it, not from a product idea.
